outputs.explanation: Panel A contains a bar chart of cell death (%) reporting mean ± s.d. of three independent experiments, but no individual data points (dots) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with only bar heights shown; no individual replicate data points are displayed, and the caption gives no indication of averaging with points.
Panel C is a bar chart showing mean ± s.d. of three experiments at each time point, but individual data points from the replicates are not shown.
Panel D contains a bar chart of cell death (%) with error bars but no individual data points overlaid on the bars.
